Predict species using a BirdNET geo model

Source: R/predict.R
birdnet_predict.birdnet_model_geo.Rd

Predicts which species occur at a location and week of the year with a BirdNET geo model.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'birdnet_model_geo'
birdnet_predict(
  model,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  week = NULL,
  min_confidence = 0.03,
  half_precision = NULL,
  year_round_aggregation = NULL,
  device = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

model

A BirdNET model object of class birdnet_model_geo, see birdnet_load().

latitude

A numeric value representing the latitude of the location.

longitude

A numeric value representing the longitude of the location.

week

An integer value representing the week of the year (1-48). If NULL (default), predicts for the whole year.

min_confidence

A numeric value to set the minimum confidence threshold for predictions.

half_precision

A logical value indicating whether to store the model's outputs as float16 (inference itself runs at the model's precision). If NULL (default), the default of the birdnet Python package is used.

year_round_aggregation

"max" or "average": how weekly scores are combined when week = NULL. If NULL (default), the model's own default ("max") is used.

device

A character string, "CPU" or "GPU". If NULL (default), the CPU is used.

...

Not used. Passing any other argument is an error.

Value

An S3 object of class birdnet_prediction_geo and birdnet_prediction containing the prediction results.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Load a BirdNET geo model
model <- birdnet_load(type = "geo")
# Predict species for a specific location and week
predictions <- birdnet_predict(model, latitude = 50.8334, longitude = 12.9231, week = 18L)
# Convert predictions to a data frame
as.data.frame(predictions)
} # }
